annotations.title: Delivery fee and minimum for a ZIP

description: Look up the delivery fee and minimum order for a Texas delivery zip code. Use when a customer asks what delivery costs or what the minimum order is for their area. ALWAYS pass event_date when the customer has mentioned their party date - minimum orders vary by date and the dated answer is exact. Without a date the answer is the general rule.

event_date.description: Event date YYYY-MM-DD, when the customer has mentioned it. Always include if known.
